method: Cross-split leakage auditing reuses the global lexical/semantic candidate graphs generated before splitting. Pair similarity is invariant to split membership, so recalculating all pairwise TF-IDF/E5 similarities is unnecessary. Direct raw and normalized exact duplicate checks are additionally performed on the provisional split files.
decision_policy: Exact or normalized-exact cross-split matches are critical. Surviving Stage6B duplicate-pool pairs carrying the same target category require split-specific human review before the test set can be frozen. Different-category high-similarity pairs are treated as informational hard negative boundaries rather than direct leakage.
